contract: Visual refresh of the Persian RTL accounting desktop app. Preserve accounting workflows, two-theme support, dense report tables, keyboard operation, and the existing Qt widget architecture.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard-check.log records that the document description and fiscal-year labels focus their controls and Tab moves focus between navigation items. The entry table accepted focus and shows a visible focus border in light-1440x900-entry-focus.png. Visible labels remain beside inputs; the attachment list has an accessible name. This is a focused UI check, not a full assistive-technology audit.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and inspected the entry form and account browse at 1440x900, 1280x800, and 1024x768. At 1024x768 the report uses vertical scrolling so results remain reachable; fewer table rows fit without scrolling.

loading.reason: The reviewed local desktop pages run synchronous queries and do not expose a progressive loading state.

empty.evidence: light-1440x900-entry.png shows the empty attachment state with the next action, while the attachment list remains empty.

error.evidence: error-1440x900-invalid-date.png captures the existing Persian invalid-date validation message.

partial.evidence: light-1440x900-browse-filtered.png shows a report filtered to one selected currency while retaining its filter context.

success.evidence: light-1440x900-browse-success.png shows populated account rows and balances.

permission.evidence: permission-viewer-1440x900-entry.png was captured with a viewer role; the save/post actions were disabled and the posting control carried the permission hint.

renderedEvidence.observation: Primary action hierarchy is clear, the focused document grid has a visible outline, and the empty attachment guidance is readable.
Dark theme preserves readable report headers, filters, currency checkboxes, and row contrast.
The report result table shows multiple rows with clear header and row separation.
The result table remains visible below the filters; additional rows are available through the page scroll.
The compact layout retains filters and a reachable result table with vertical scrolling.
